tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa 'dod dgu'i gter mdzod ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mchog tu dang por ye shes bdud rtsi yi/ /bka' drin stsol mdzad bla mar phyag bgyis nas/ /gang gi thugs rje'i 'od zer las shar ba/ /'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la'ang 'dud/ /rgyal dang de sras rgya mtsho'i mkhyen pa kun/ /gcig tu bsdus pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /yan lag bdun ldan rigs kyi dkyil 'khor spro/ /mkhyen pa'i 'od kyis bdag blo gsal bar mdzod/ / bskyed rim kun gyi gtso bo zla med pa/ /'dus pa'i lam bzang ye shes zhabs kyi srol/ / phyogs 'dir ring mo zhig nas nyams pa de/ /rgyas par bya phyir 'di la spro ba skyes/ /ma lus rgyud sde'i chu klung kun/ /'dus pa'i rgya mtsho cher 'jug pa/ /lugs bzang mchog 'di mthong ba na/ / lugs gzhan dag ni 'od mi gsal/ /de phyir mkhas pa rnams kyis ni/ /lam mchog 'di la nyer brten 'os/ /'di la grub pa'i dga' ston ni/ /mtha' yas ci yi phyir mi 'thob/ / 'dir rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la nye bar brten nas bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog nyid kyang*/ lus kyi chos 'di nyid kya ིsa bde blag tu mngon par bsgrub par 'dod pa dag gis lugs 'di la nan tan tu bya bar 'os so/ /de la 'di ni dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa sngags kyi dngos grub mchog brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas dpal ye shes kyi zhal snga nas kyis/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po las mngon sum du nod pa'i gdams ngag yin no/ /de yang sgrub pa'i thabs kun tu bzang po las/ la lar dri med chu ni phun tshogs shing*/

/shing mchog mdzes pas rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /ri bo'i phyogs gcig tu ni bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba rab tu sgrub/ ces gsungs pa ltar yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su bde ba'i stan pa 'dug ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rdo rje sems pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dpral bar oṃ nas hūṃ gi bar/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang bskur/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ dkar po'i mthar yi ge brgya ba'i sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa sgrib pa nyes pa ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab la/ rdo rje sems pa'i yi ge brgya ba ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar/ phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gus pas khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rdo rje sems par bdag sgrub mdzod/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dang zhes pa nas/ byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ de nyid ji srid du sdig pa byang ba'i mtshan mthong gi bar du bsgom par bya la/ de nas ji skad du/ cho ga bzhin du rjes gnang byas pa yi/ /blo dang ldan pas rang sngags bsnyen pa bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/

me tog phog pa'i lha de nyid dang por bsgrub par bya ste/ der sems brtan pa dang*/ lha de nyid mnyes pa'i mtshan pa cung zad mthong bar bya'o/ / des dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyas pa yang sgom nus par 'gyur bas/ da ni 'di'i rim pa bshad par bya ste/ 'di la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la/ mthun rkyen sgrub pa tshogs gnyis gsog pa dang*/ 'gal rkyen 'gog pa bsrung 'khor sgom pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis kyi dang po bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa ni/ rang skad cig gis 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba dri ma med pa la gnas pa'i maṃ yig dmar ser rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar 'jig rten gyi dbul ba sel bar byed pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rigs bdag gi rnam pa can gyis dbu brgyan pa'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+taṃ pra ṇi mya badz+ra ban+dhā nāṃ ka ro mi/ dpal ldan bde rdzogs zab gsal gnyis med 'od zer ldan/ /de yi rang bzhin zhi ba bcu drug phyed cha 'bar/ /don dam snying po de ston bla ma gsum po rab/ /de la bya byed gsum mnyam pa yi rtag tu 'dud/ / ces bla ma dang*/ dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs dri med gzi brjid ldan/ /dpag med rigs kyi sprul pa rnams kyis rab brgyan zhing*/ /shes rab yan lag 'dus pa 'bar zhing rab mdzes pa/ /'jam dpal gang de mchod phyir de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes yi dam la phyag bya/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ de bzhin du 'dir/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke / gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta/ rū pa/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+sha dharma dhā tu badz+ra rnams sbyar ro/ / gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung du/ /ma lus kun rtog gis bsags rnyog pa rnams/

/thugs rje che ldan spyan sngar de dag ni/ /cho ga bzhin du thams cad bshad par bgyi/ / rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems pa dang*/ /'phags pa gzhan gyi dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yi rang zhing*/ /byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /yid kyi rol pa dri med zla 'dras bsgrub/ / snying rje dam pa mtha' yas pa yi thabs/ /rang gi yid la gnas par gyur pa yi/ /bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grol zhing*/ /sems pa dam pa rnams kyi phun tshogs gzhi/ /dngos po thams cad ro gcig ngo bo nyid/ /dam pa'i chos la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /'ching ba rnams las nges par grol gyur cig /snying rje mchog gis bskrun pa'i dpal dang ldan/ /rab tu dga' sogs sa la rab bzhugs pa'i/ /brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /bsam dang rnam par smin pa dag gyur pas/ / sgrib pa kun gyi bag chags yang dag 'byin/ /lhag par mos pas rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /sems ni byang chub dam pa bskyed par bgyid/ /bde gshegs sras bcas rnams kyi lam gcig pu/ /sbyin sogs rnams bcu dkar po'i yon tan tshul/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas bdag ma lus ngo bo'i blos/ /yang dag nyid du da ni gnas par bgyi/ /sems can thams cad bde dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /bdag gis sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i don du 'jam pa'i rdo rje thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang gzhan thams cad 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad mgo snyoms pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par bgyi'o/ / gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs ni/ ngo bo nyid dang bral phyir stong pa ste/ /rang bzhin rgyu dang bral bas mtshan ma med/ /rtog pa rnams dang bral phyir dngos rnams kun/ /ma lus smon pa las ni nges par grol/ / oṃ shū n+yā tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

zhes brjod do/ / stong pa'i ngang las/ nam mkha'i khams su āḥlas byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ rang gi bar do'i ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūṃ sngon po rnams thabs shes chags sems kyi rang bzhin ho dmar po gnyis kyi mtha' brten pa byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gyur/ gnyis pa la thun mong gi bsrung 'khor dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung 'khor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'og tu aṃ las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa'i lte bar nyi ma la hūṃ nag po/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas bgegs thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ 'od zer slar 'dus nas 'og tu 'phros pas/ 'og thams cad sra zhing brtan pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs rnams su 'phros pas rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng du 'phros pas gur dang bla bre/ de thams cad dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i me kha dog lnga pa rab tu 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ de'i dbus su/ oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba'i steng du/ bh+ruṃ ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa g.yas bskor du mgyogs par 'khor ba/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i sprin gyi 'phreng ba phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ de'i lte ba'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi rtsibs brgyad kyi rtse mo'i steng dang*/ steng 'og gi rtsibs kyi nang rnams su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/ de rnams kyi steng du hūṃ re re/ de yang lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ steng gi ser po/ gzhan rnams sngon po/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus dang shar sogs phyogs dang me sogs mtshams g.yas bskor dang*/ steng 'og rnams su rim pas/ rdo rje dang*/ tho ba dang*/ dbyug pa dkar po dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ rdo rje kha gyes pa dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ dbyug pa sngon po dang*/

rtse gsum dang*/ ral gri dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje rnams hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su hūṃ mdzad nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyi nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ shar du gshin rje mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis tho ba dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du sbyar ste/ lho ru shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum= g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po dang ral gri= nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum= g.yas gnyis kyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum= g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje nag po kha gyes pa dang*/ gzhan hūṃ mdzad bzhin/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum= g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang rdo rje= shar lho 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i= g.yas gnyis kyi lcags kyu dang = lho nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po sngon dkar dmar ba= g.yas gnyis kyis dbyug pa sngon po dang = nub byang du stobs po che nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal= g.yas gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang = steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ser po = ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum= g.yas gnyis kyis 'khor lo ser po dang = 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o//mi g.yo ba 'dod rgyal gnod mdzes hūṃ mdzad rnams sgeg pa'i nyams can mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/

dbu skra nag po'i thor tshugs la rin po che'i cod pan dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ khro bo gzhan thams cad sbom zhing thung ba mi sdug pa'i nyams can/ mche ba drag tu gtsigs shing ljags 'gyur ba/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra dmar ser/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ gshin rje mthar byed la rnam snang*/ pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pa yab yum re res dbu brgyan pa'o/ /thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ snying kha nas 'od 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bskur/ oṃ kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ khro bo bcu'i mtshan sngags sam/ rtsa sngags rgyud las 'byung ba rnams kyang spro na bzla bar bya'o/ /mdor bsdus su sgom na gong du 'bar bas bskor ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur zhes brjod de/ khro bo bcu 'khor lo dang bcas bzhag kyang rung ngo*/ /gal te phyir bzlog bya bar 'dod na/ dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dang*/ steng du hūṃ mdzad sgom pa ni khyad par te de dang*/ gzhan yang bsrung bya sba ba'i gnad lha'i rnam pa'i gnad/ 'khor lo bskor ba'i gnad/ sngags kyi bzlas pa'i gnad de/ gnad lnga ldan du bya ba dang*/ gzhan dag rgyas par uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i gdams ngag lugs gnyis su shes par bya'o/ /de'i bzlas pa ni/ oṃ āḥ uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra brti/ sarba lo ki ka lo kot+ta ra ni yan+d+ra mān+t+ra bi tsūr+ṇā ya/ pra yo gā dī ni/ ma ma kṛ te ye na ke na tsit+k+ri tā ni/ ka ri ha tā ni ha na sarba ni/ tshin+da tshin+da/ bin+dha bin+dha kaṃ pa kaṃ pa ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/

bi dhān+pa ya bi dhān+pa ya/ sha da sa ha sra/ bi tsur+ṇā ya bi tsur+ṇā ya/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra brti bh+ruṃ bh+ruṃ bh+ruṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dang po sbyor ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog dang*/ las rgyal po mchog gsum las/ dang po la/ rten bskyed pa dang*/ brten pa bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dbus kyi khro bo yongs su gyur pa las saṃ las rdo rje dkar po saṃ gis mtshan pa las/ kun bzang dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zla ba'i 'od can/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches spras pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ nam mkha'i khams bde ba chen po rang bzhin chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ rtsa ba phra ba/ thur du zug pa/ gdeng kha che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs kyi 'od zer 'phro ba/ de'i nang du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa/ lte bar hūṃ nag po las/ sna tshogs rdo rje yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i lte bar zla ba la/ bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu gnyis pa bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas rnams bde ba chen pos mchod rnam snang gi rnam par spyan drangs te/ bh+ruṃ la thim yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam snang dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zla ba'i 'od can/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ thar pa chen po'i khang bzang gzhal yas khang rin po che sna lnga las rdzogs par grub pa/ thub pa'i dbang po'i 'od zer gyis mtha' yas pa'i phyogs kun tu khyab pa/

gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu dmar pos bskor ba'i steng na gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang ba'i drwa ba drwa phyed/ de'i steng du bya 'dabs las 'phyang ba'i shar bu/ steng du mda' yab mchod rten gyi dbyibs can gyis yongs su bskor ba la/ rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi 'gram 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la/ bzhugs stangs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gzungs ma rnams kyis mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du/ bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi'am snam bu bcu gcig gi rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mos brgyan pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi phyi mtshams dang*/ grwa bzhis zla phyed la gnas pa'i rin po che dmar po la rdo rjes mtshan pas brgyan pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du/ bum pa bzang po las skyes pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ sprin gyi gseb nas byung ba'i lha mo me tog gi phreng ba thogs pa rnams kyis brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi tshad kyi phyi ngos su/ 'od zer rnam pa lnga'i phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du/ rdo rje rtse gsum pas zlum por bskor ba la brten pa'i ka ba brgyan dang ldan pa ste/ shar du 'khor lo/ lho ru rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa'i ka ba gnyis kyis btegs pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che tog gis spras pa rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi'i g.yas g.yon du bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/

mchod pa'i sprin thams cad kyis mngon par brgyan pa'i khang bzang dam pa/ nang bltas phyi gsal zhing phyi bltas nang gsal ba'i nang gi steng 'og gi gzhi rnams/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i nang le tshe dgu dang*/ rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi dang*/ shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon gnyis dang*/ sgo bzhi rnams su sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan re re/ nang gi shar las gzhan pa'i phyogs gsum dang*/ sgo bzhi rnams su nyi ma'i gdan/ gzhan rnams su zla ba'i gdan re re ste/ ye shes kyi gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/

spro na dag pa 'di yang brjod de/ mi mnyam pa dag med pas zur bzhir mnyam/ /dran dang dbang po mchog gi sgo rnams yin/ /bsam gtan bzhi po rnams kyi rta babs te/ /ting 'dzin kha khyer gyis ni legs par bskor/ /kha khyer der legs brten pa'i mchod pa ni/ /dam pa 'dzin rnams gzungs kyi tshogs yin no/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan pa ni/ /gang phyir 'gro ba'i bsam kun rdzogs byed pa'o/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i ba dan phreng ba dang*/ /sgra sgrog dril bus phyogs sgo kun khyab pa/ /gang phyir dam chos gsung rab yan lag dgu/ /gdul bya thams cad la ni bskyod pa'o/ /me long drwa ba drwa phyed me tog gi/ phreng ba sna tshogs kyis brgyan mnyam med pa/ /me long ye shes dri med byang chub kyi/ /yan lag me tog dri ni phun sum tshogs/ /ka ba bzang po brgyad kyis nyer mdzes pa/ /rnam thar brgyad po rnam par dag pa yin/ /rdo rje'i thig dang yang dag ldan pa ni/ /rdo rje theg chos 'khor lo rab bskor ba'o/ /bla med mtha' yas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /gzugs sogs yul rnams rnam par dag pa yin/ /mchod pa lnga yis rnam par brgyan pa ni/ /chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i rgyu mthun no/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar legs gnas pa'i/ /nyi zla mgon bcas lha yi gdan rnams ni/ /skyon gyis ma gos mi shes mun sel zhing*/ /nyon mongs tsha gdung zhi bar byed pa'o/ / gnyis pa brten pa bskyed pa la/ bsnyen sgrub chung ngu dang*/ bar ma gnyis/ dang po la/ bsnyen pa/ nyer sgrub/ sgrub pa/ sgrub chen bzhi las/ dang po ni/ dbus kyi zla ba'i gdan la bar snang gi yi ge las 'phros pa'i rang gi sgo gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum gzugs brnyan ltar gsal bas/ bdag nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs su 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir du/ phyogs bcu'i sems can gyi don la bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul bas de rnams kyis rang la byin gyis brlabs shing 'od du zhu nas 'og tu/

a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ rnams g.yas bskor dang*/ slar yang a ā nas aṃ aḥ rnams g.yon bskor te/ mtshan so gnyis kyi rang bzhin dbyangs so gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs dkar po so gnyis kyis mtshan pa'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ya ra la wa ḍa dha rnams g.yas bskor dang*/ slar yang ka nas dha rnams g.yon bskor te/ dpe byad brgyad cu'i rang bzhin gsal byed brgyad cu yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed dmar po brgyad cu'i mtshan pa de ltar zla ba gnyis ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa me long lta bu'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /zla ba de gnyis dbyer med du 'dres nas gcig tu gyur pa ni nyon yid gnas gyur pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /zla ba'i steng du hūṃ dmar po las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa nor bu pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba'i lte bar/ zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig dkar po 'od zer 'bar bas mtshan pa ni yid shes gnas gyur pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /hūṃ gi 'od zer gyi 'gro ba thams cad rnam par sbyangs shing rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang la bkod de/ slar 'dus nas hūṃ la thim pa ni dbang shes gnas gyur pa bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra at+ma ko3haṃ/ slar yang hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bde ba chen pos mnyes par byas nas/ rdo rje sems pa'i rnam par spyan drangs pa rnams hūṃ la thim pa'i rkyen gyis/ zla ba rdo rje hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid thub pa'i dbang po kun gyi rdul phra rab las byung ba 'gro ba rnams kyi de kho na nyid sangs rgyas kun gyi yab tu gyur pa'i rdo rje sems pa kun tu bzang po dkar po

zhes pa nas/ rin po ches spras pa 'i bar gong bzhin/ de ltar sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs gnas gyur pa dag pa gnyis ldan chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /oṃ ya thā sarba ta thā ga ta ta thā a haṃ/ de dag ni rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa pha ma dang 'dra ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /'dod chags chen pos gdul ba'i sems can rnams la/ gsang ba 'dus pa ston par dgongs te/ yab yum snyom par zhugs pa'i shin tu dga' ba'i sgra'i dbyangs kyis rgyal ba yab yum thams cad spyan drangs/ rang gi lus la zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis/ rang nyid bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pas yum mnyes par gyur zhing*/ rang gi lus las spyan sogs yum bzhi dang*/ gzugs sogs lha mo lnga ste/ rig ma dgu phyir spros te yum la thim pas/ yum bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pas yab mnyes par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa lha bcu dgu'i bdag nyid du spyan drangs/ rang gi zhal nas zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pas/ thig le yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bdag nyid rdo rje sems pas gtso byas pa'i lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal la yongs su rdzogs pa dus gcig tu grub pa las 'phros pa'i 'od dang*/ rang gi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad bkug nas slob ma 'jug pa'i tshul du dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas bcug ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du 'khod par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rigs lnga yum bzhi sems pa sems ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ rjes su chags pa'i mes byang chub kyi sems su ro gcig par gyur/ rdo rje'i lam nas 'thon te/

sems can de rnams la dbang bskur bas phung khams skye mched thams cad sbyangs nas/ thig ler zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las/ k+ṣiṃ dziṃ khaṃ gaṃ skaṃ saṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ rnams las byung ba'i sa snying dang*/ phyag rdor dang*/ nam snying dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ sgrib sel dang*/ kun bzang dang*/ gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya dang*/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma dang*/ spyan ma dang*/ mā ma kī dang*/ gos dkar mo dang*/ sgrol ma dang*/ rnam snang dang*/ rin 'byung dang*/ 'od dpag med dang*/ don grub dang*/ mi bskyod pa ste/ lha nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan mtshan dpe la sogs pa tshang la yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa rnams/ k+ṣiṃ nas hūṃ gi bar gong bzhin brjod/ pad+ma nas phyir spros pa nam mkhar 'khod nas bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i tshul gyis bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pha'o/ /bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ma'o/ /bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ston pa'o/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byang chub sems kyi 'jug pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang*/ /rnyog med rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ / zhes ched du brjod pa ched du brjod nas rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur to/ /de dag ni spun zla lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin no/ / bdag nyid dri za'i tshul du gnas pas/ sangs rgyas yab yum 'dod chags chen po'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba mthong ba'i rkyen gyis/ bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pa yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa chos 'byung gi phyag rgya'i 'od kyis reg ma thag tu 'dod chags chen po'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar po'i thig ler gyur/ de'i 'od kyis yab yum gnyis kyang byang chub sems su zhu ba dang lhan cig zla ba zhu ba lta bu'i thig le dri ma med pa'i 'od 'phro bar gyur te/

spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i 'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa chos sku'i ngang du zhugs par gyur to/ / de nas sngon yun ring du goms pa'i rang gi byams sogs tshad med bzhi'i rang bzhin lha mo bzhir gyur pa rnams mtshams bzhir 'khod nas/ snyan pa'i glu dbyangs kyis bskul ba ni/ mā ma kīs/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ / spyan mas/ rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rjes su phan brtson pa/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ / gos dkar mos/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan cing thugs brtse ba/ /'jig rten dag gi dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ /mgon po= /rab dka'i spyod pa kun tu bzang pos bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ / sgrol mas/ khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa/ /mgon po= /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ces bskul bas sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du mdzad pa'i thig le de thig le gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig yongs su gyur pa las 'od zer rnam pa lnga 'phro ba'i maṃ yig dmar ser du gyur/ de las byung ba'i ral gri sngon po gser gyi yu bas brgyan pa 'od kyi drwa bas bskor ba'i yu ba la gnas pa'i zla ba'i steng du maṃ yig gis mtshan pa las/ 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ sems can thams cad 'jam dpal gyi go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas rnams dang lhan cig 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs te maṃ yig la thim/

ral gri zla ba maṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar ser gur kum gzhon nu lta bu/ btso ma gser gyi lhun po la/ nyi ma 'char kha'i mdangs 'bum phrag phog pa ltar gzi 'od 'bar ba/ g.yas zhal in+d+ra ni la ltar sngo sangs/ g.yon zhal ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gsum ka'ang rab tu zhi ba'i spyan dkyus ring zhing yangs la bkra ba gnyis gnyis dang rab tu mdzes pa'i smin tshugs kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i sor gdub gyis spras pa'i phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri mda'/ g.yon gnyis kyis ut+pal dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ mchog tu sgeg pa'i gzhon nu dpag tu med pa'i rigs kyi sprul pa phyogs bcur 'phro zhing*/ mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud lnga la/ dri zhim me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ nyi zla'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar zhing*/ sil sil gyi sgra sgrog pa'i rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ do shal/ dpung rgyan/ gdu bu/ sen mo do dang ska rags te/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ snyan gong ut+pa la'i gdengs ka dang*/ dar dpyangs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol zhing*/ srid zhi'i mtha' las brgal ba/ sku gsung thugs ky-i yon tan thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bu lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin no/ / oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gnyis pa nyer sgrub ni/ mig tu mig dbang k+ṣiṃ las 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i k+ṣiṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bde bas mnyes/ sa snying gi rnam par spyan drangs nas thim/

de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sa snying dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ rna bar rna ba'i dbang po'i= dz+riṃ nag po = rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar yang dz+riṃ nag po/ phyag rdor gyi rnam par spyan drangs= yongs su gyur pa las/ phyag rdor nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum= g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyi nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ snar khaṃ ser po= rin po che ljang gu cha dgu pa= nam mkha'i snying po ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal= g.yas gnyis nor bu dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lce la gaṃ dmar po= pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa= 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i = g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ skra mtshams kyi dpral ba'i nang du lus kyi dbang po'i ngo bo skaṃ ljang gu= ral gri sngo sangs 'od 'phro ba= sgrib sel ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal= g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lte bar yid kyi dbang po'i ngo bo saṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa= kun bzang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum= g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rdo rje skyil mo krung gis zla gdan la bzhugs shing*/ zla ba'i 'od 'phro ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ / de dag ni rgyas pa'o/ /gal te 'bring du mos na sa bon las de dag bskyed pa tsam gyis rung zhing*/ bsdu na yid kyis 'bring ltar gsal btab nas/ ngag tu/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ dkar po las sa snying*/ rna bar dziṃ nag po las phyag rdor/ snar khaṃ ser po las nam snying*/ lcer gaṃ dmar po las 'jig rten dbang phyug

/dpral bar skaṃ ljang gu las sgrib sel/ lte bar saṃ sngon po las kun bzang*/ zhes pa tsam brjod kyang rung ngo*/ / gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ rang gi nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i rang gi sems kyi ngo bo hūṃ nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar yang hūṃ nag po/ de las 'od 'phros 'gro ba rnams thugs rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bde bas mnyes/ thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs nas thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ thugs rdo rje nag po sogs phyag rdor lta bu'i thugs kar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga'i lte bar zla ba la hūṃ sngon po/ de bzhin du 'don pa spos te/ mgrin pa'i nang du= ngag gi ngo bo āḥ dmar po= pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa= gsung rdo rje dmar po sogs gong*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'dra ba'i thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la āḥ dmar po/ spyi bor= rang gi lus kyi= oṃ dkar po/ 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i/ sku rdo rje dkar po sogs gong sa snying lta bu/ thugs dkar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ thams cad kyang rdo rje'i skyil krung

sogs gong ltar ro/ / de gsum gyi thugs ka'i yi ge 'bru gsum las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros shing*/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa mchod pa'i lha mo mtha' yas pa sprul te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis bsrung 'khor skabs ltar mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum sgom pa/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum sgom pa/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ / rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs rdo rje dang de'i rdo rje can rnams thugs rdo rje rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ chos kyi gsung laṃ dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi phyed= /deng bdag= /rdo rje gsung gi= /phyogs bcur sogs gong ltar las/ rdo rje gsung gis= ces gsol ba btab pas gsung rdo rje dang de'i rdo rje can rnams gsung rdo rje dang rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bāka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed= /deng bdag= /rdo rje sku yis= /phyogs bcur= /rdo rje sku yis= /ces gsol ba btab pas/ sku rdo rje dang de'i rdo rje can rnams sku rdo rje dang rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gal te 'bring por mos na/ phyag mtshan sa bon las rdo rje gsum bskyed kyang rung la/ bsdu na skad cig gis bskyed nas cho ga lhag ma bya dgos te/ gsol 'debs gsum dang thim tshul bsnyen sgrub 'bring po ltar yang rung*/ bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po ni/ rang gi snying ga'i thugs rdo rje'i gong du zla ba la gnas pa'i maṃ yig dmar ser yongs su gyur pa las/

ral gri yu ba'i nang du zla ba la maṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byas/ 'jam dpal gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas maṃ la thim/ ral gri zla ba maṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /dang po gnyis rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis ut+pal dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems pa ral gri'i yu bar zla ba la gnas pa'i maṃ dmar ser ro/ / bsdu na snying gar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems pa ral gri maṃ dang bcas pa'o/ / zhes brjod cing dmigs pa tsam gyis kyang mchog go / thugs ka'i maṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ / zhes pa'am/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// ces gsol ba btab nas/ rigs lngas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu dang bcas pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ yum rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa ye shes bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/

rang gi spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing*/ sa snying la sogs pa rnams la'ang rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ spro na ye shes sems pa thugs rdo rje phyag rdor kun bzang rnams la mi bskyod pa sku rdo rje dang sa snying la rnam snang*/ nam mkha'i snying po la rin 'byung*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dang gsung rdo rje la 'od dpag med/ sgrib pa rnam sel la don grub rnams kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang la gnyis su med par thim/ de dag ni yan lag bzhi chung ngu'i skor ro/ / gnyis pa la yang bzhi las/ dang po bsnyen pa ni/ rang gi mdun na gnas pa'i thig le yongs su gyur pa las/ yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar ser gur kum gzhon nu lta bu/ g.yas sngo zhing g.yon dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gtso bo'i mgul nas 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis ut+pal dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung gis yab la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra ltag par phyed bcing shing*/ phyed sil bur grol bas sku stod khyab pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa ltar gzhon nu lang tsho la bab cing*/ nu 'bur rgyas pa/ gnyen lcug 'khril bag chags pa'i sku sgeg cing mchog tu mdzes pa/ shin tu 'dzum pa'i zur gyis lta ba la sogs pa sgyu rtsal gyi nyams dang ldan pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' dang cod pan can/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ shes rab kyi yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ dharma sogs gong bzhin brjod/ gnyis pa nyer sgrub ni/ las kyi phyag rgya'i dbang du byas nas gong bzhin rgyas pa dang*/ 'dir ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i dbang du byas nas/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ dang 'khor lo'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las sa snying dkar po zhes sogs sbyar te/ rna bar dziṃ dang rdo rje= snar khaṃ dang rin po che= lcer gaṃ dang pad+ma= dpral bar skaṃ dang ral gri=

lte bar saṃ dang rdo rje zhes sogs sbyar ba ni khyad par ro/ /bsdus pa yang gong bzhin no/ /gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ rgyas par na gong bzhin las/ lus ngag yid kyi ngo bo zhes pa rnams bor ba dang*/ rigs gsum gyi gsol btab bor ba dang*/ sngags gsum mjug tu sbrel nas brjod pa ni khyad par te bsdus pa yang rigs 'dre'o/ / bzhi pa sgrub chen ni/ gzhan rnams gong dang 'dra ba las/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gnas su/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma zhes pa dang*/ rang la mi bskyod pas zhes pa'i skabs su/ yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma la zhes 'don pa spo ba ni khyad par ro/ /'dir gzhung gi dngos bstan ni dngos kyi phyag rgya'i dbang du byas pa ste/ de la mngon byang bzhi pas yan chad dmigs pa gcig cing lnga pa mdzad pa dang bcas pa'i bar du/ bdag nyid yab dang*/ rig ma yum gyi nga rgyal gnyis kas bya/ zhu ba na gnyis ka dmigs pa gcig cing*/ 'bras bu rdor 'dzin bzhengs nas sgrub chen rdzogs kyi bar ni/ sgrub pa pos dkyus ltar gyi dmigs pa dang*/ rig mas kyang rang nyid thig le'i gzugs kyis nga rgyal gnas nas/ mdun du bskyed pa'i tshul gyi yab kyi bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi sgom/ bsnyen sgrub 'bring po dang chen po'i skor rnams ni yab yum dmigs pa 'dra'o/ /yid kyi rig ma la brten pa la/ yab yum sbrags te bsgoms nas/ 'bring po skor bzhi logs su mi sgom pa dag ni/ yan lag bcu gnyis ma tshang ba'i phyir mi 'thad do/ / yum gyi spyi gtsug nas snying ga'i bar du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po rnam snang gi rang bzhin/ snying ga nas lte ba'i bar du hūṃ nag po mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin/ lte ba nas gsang ba'i bar du swā ser po rin 'byung gi rang bzhin/ gsang ba nas brla'i bar du āḥdamar po 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin/ brla nas byin pa'i bar du hā ljang gu don grub kyi rang bzhin rnams nyi ma la gnas pa/

de rnams kyi 'od zer rnam pa lngas gang ba'i yum gyi sku de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i rdul phra rab tu gyur/ rang gi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ dkar po las skyes pa'i nor bus mtshan pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa āḥlas skyes pa'i ze 'brus mtshan pa/ gnyis ka'i bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dga' ba dang bde ba nyams su myong ba'i bde ba chen pos sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ ces nga rgyal bya ste/ dang po sbyor ba'o/ / gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la yang*/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi las/ dang po bsnyen pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i laṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs pa rnams/ rang gi zhal nas zhugs te/ rjes chags kyi mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa'i thig le maṃ yig dmar ser gyis mtshan cing byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo thig le de yongs su gyur pa las/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gdan dang bcas pa yongs su grub pa'i dbus kyi gdan la/ rgyal ba mi bskyod rdo rje sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis khro bo'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa rang gi thugs kar drangs/ badz+ra dhṛka thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/

phyogs bcu'i zhing du sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ khyad par du sems can rnams kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ thugs rdo rje dang chos dbyings ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus te rang nyid la thim par gyur/ shar du rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs kar drangs/ dzi na dzika thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ phyogs bcu'i zhing du sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ khyad par du sems can rnams kyi gti mug sbyangs/ gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ sku rdo rje dang me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus te phyi'i gzhal yas khang gi le tshe dgu'i shar du zla gnas la 'khod/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ lhor rin 'byung nam snying lta bu rin po che ljang gu cha dgu pa 'dzin pa/ rat+na dhṛka khyad par du sems can rnams kyi nga rgyal sbyangs/ tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ yon tan rdo rje dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/ lhor nyi gdan la 'khod/ nub tu 'od dpag med 'jig rten dbang phyug lta bu pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa 'dzin pa/ ā ro l̥ka /khyad par du 'dod chags sbyangs/ 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ gsung rdo rje dang so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la bkod/ nub tu nyi gdan la 'khod/ byang du don grub sgrib sel lta bu ral gri sngon po 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa/ pradz+nya dhṛka /khyad par du phrag dog sbyang*/ 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ 'phrin las rdo rje dang bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ byang du nyi gdan la gnas/

'di man chad du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad ces pa'i mdzad pa spyi'i tshig 'di mi brjod do/ / gzhan thams cad sbyor lugs 'dra bar byas te/ rang 'od kyi yab la zhes sbyar nas shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo rnam snang lta bu/ mo ha ra tī/ sems can rnams kyi sa'i khams kyi dri ma sbyangs/ snying rje tshad med mngon du byas/ thabs kyi phar phyin= shar lhor zla gdan la'o/ /lho nub tu mā ma kī sngon mo mi bskyod pa lta bu ut+pal la dmar po 'dzin pa/ dwe ṣa ra tī/ chu'i khams/ byams pa tshad med pa/ smon lam gyi phar phyin/ lho nub tu zla gdan la/ nub byang du gos dkar mo 'od dpag med lta bu la rā ga ra tī/ me khams/ dga' ba tshad med pa/ stobs kyi phar phyin/ nub byang du zla gdan la/ byang shar du sgrol ma ser mo rin 'byung lta bu la rin po che'i gnas su ut+pal ser po/ badz+ra ra tī/ rlung gi khams/ btang snyoms tshad med/ ye shes kyi phar phyin/ byang shar du zla gdan la 'khod/ de bzhin du/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma rnam snang lta bu la/ 'khor lo'i gnas su me long dmar po/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rang gi thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ phyogs bcu'i zhing du sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi gzugs kyi skye mched sbyangs te/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin la bkod nas/ slar 'dus te rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor zla gdan la 'khod/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su pi waṃ sngon po/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sgra'i skye mched/ tshul khrims kyi phar phyin/ lho nub tu zla gdan/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma rin 'byung lta bu la rin po che'i gnas su dri'i dung chos ser po/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dri'i skye mched/ bzod pa'i phar phyin/ nub byang du zla gdan la/ byang shar du ro rdo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med lta bu la/

pad+ma'i gnas su ro'i snod dmar po/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ro'i skye mched/ brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin/ byang shar du zla gdan la/ shar sgo'i g.yas su reg bya rdo rje ma ljang gu don grub lta bu la/ ral gri'i gnas su gos kha dog sna tshogs pa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ reg bya'i skye mched/ bsam gtan gyi phar phyin/ shar sgo'i g.yas su zla gdan la/ shar sgo'i g.yon du chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo rdo rje sems pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ chos kyi skye mched/ shes rab kyi phar phyin/ shar sgo'i g.yon du zla gdan la 'khod/ de thams cad kyang zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan dang phyed bcings kyis mdzes la/ zhal re re la shin tu zhi ba'i spyan gnyis gnyis dang ldan zhing brgyad gnyis lon pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ sgeg cing 'dzum pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis bde ba chen po'i longs spyod la lhag par rol ba nyi zla'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar zhing rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas klubs pa'o/ /rnam snang dang lha mo thams cad zla ba'i 'od 'phro ba/ gshegs pa gzhan gsum nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ba'o/ /

de bzhin sngar bzhin du sbyar te/ shar sgor gshin rje gshed nag po mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su rdo rje tho ba/ ya mān+ta kṛta/ sems can rnams kyi phung po'i bdud thams cad sbyangs/ dad pa'i dbang po la bkod/ slar 'dus te shar sgor nyi gdan la 'khod/ lho sgor shes rab mthar byed dkar po rnam snang lta bu la/ 'khor lo'i gnas su rdo rje dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ pradz+nyān+ta kṛta/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud thams cad sbyangs/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po la bkod/ lho sgor nyi gdan/ nub sgor pad+ma mthar byed 'od dpag med lta bu/ pad+mān+ta kṛta/ 'chi bdag gi bdud sbyangs/ dran pa'i dbang po la bkod/ nub sgor nyi gdan la/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed nag po mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su/ rdo rje nag po kha gyes pa 'dzin pa/ bigh+nān+ta kṛta/ lha'i bu'i bdud sbyangs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po la bkod/ slar 'dus te byang sgor nyi gdan la 'khod/ khro bo bzhi po thams cad kyang sbom zhing thung la mi sdug pa'i nyams can dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing*/ smin ma dang*/ sma ra dmar ser rab tu 'bar ba/ zhal re re yang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan cing*/ mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ ha ha'i gad rgyangs drag po sgrog cing*/ bzhin shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ gsus khyim che zhing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing*/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa ni/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas sngon po'i dbu skra bcings shing*/ 'jog po dmar pos rna rgyan byas pa/ rigs ldan khra bos dpung pa la brgyan cing*/ pad+ma dkar pos mgul rgyan byas pa/ dung skyong ser pos lag gdub byas shing*/ stobs rgyu ljang gus mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ nor rgyas kyi bu bdud rtsi'i kha dog lta bus ske rags byas shing*/

pad+ma chen po dkar po rkang gdub byas pa/ stobs chen pha rol gnon pa/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las la brtson pas g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang rang gi thugs kar drangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ thugs nas phyir phyung*/ snod kyi 'jig rten sbyangs/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ slar 'dus nas gzhal yas khang la thim/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes sems pa lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ shar sgo'i thad kyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ oṃ ya mān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ pradz+nyān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ zhes bgegs bskrad/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ya mān+ta kṛta dzaḥ oṃ pradz+nyān+ta krita hūṃ/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta baṃ/ oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛta ho/ zhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya/ gnyis pa nyer sgrub ni/ lha thams cad kyi mig tu zla ba la zhes pa nas/ brgyan pa'o zhes pa'i bar gtso bo'i skabs ltar bya'o/ / gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi nu ma gnyis kyi zhes sogs sbyar te nga rgyal bzung ba gsum gyi bar yum gyi skabs bzhin no/ /yan lag de gnyis kyi 'bring dang bsdus pa'i cho ga yang snga ma rnams kyi rigs bsgre'o/ / bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i maṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa sogs gong dang 'dra ba las/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam snang sogs de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi/ mā ma kī sgra rdo rje ma/ shes rab mthar byed/ bgegs mthar byed rnams la mi bskyod pa/ spyan ma/ gzugs rdo rje ma/ gshin rje gshed rnams la rnam snang*/ dri rdo rje ma la rin 'byung*/ gos dkar mo/ ro rdo rje ma/ pad+ma mthar byed rnams la 'od dpag med/ sgrol ma dang reg bya rdo rje ma la don grub/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma la rdo rje sems pas dbu brgyan cing*/

skye mched dang sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams la rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ de nas sgrub chen gyi yan lag ni/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba gsum ste/ dang po ni/ thugs ka'i maṃ las 'od zer 'phros pa/ phyogs bcu'i 'dod pa'i yon tan dang mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad bkug ste/ rang gi lus la zhugs te byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas phyung*/ pad+mar babs pa'i thig le bcu/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ rnams su gyur/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis lha mo bcu'i lha tshogs spyan drangs te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las yum bzhi dang mchod pa'i lha mo drug gzugs dang lang tsho la sogs pa yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan par gyur te/ mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la mchod par gyur/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod pa byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje mkha' 'dra dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ / rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu tī ra badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/

mtheb srin g.yon pas 'bul te/ thog mar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi mtshan nas smos shing 'bul ba'am/ bsdu na bla ma rigs bdag gi ngo bor mos dgos pa'i phyir/ lha rnams nyid kyi mtshan sngags kyis phul ba des chog pas/ logs su ma byung kyang rung tsam mo/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags re re'i mthar yi ge 'bru gsum btags pas rung ngo*/ / gsum pa las rgyal po mchog ni/ zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i tshul du shes par bya ste/ de la/ thig le'i rnal 'byor dang*/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang gi ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i ral gri'i yu bar zla ba la gnas pa'i maṃ yig dmar ser/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod pa rnams dang lhan cig de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ de la thim pa'i rkyen gyis maṃ yig 'od du zhu nas/ rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i thig le phra mo 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phro ba dwangs shing gsal ba yungs kar gyi 'bru tsam shin tu 'tsher ba la sems bzung zhing*/ sems 'phro bar rtsom pa na thig le de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ral gri dang*/ de las ye shes sems dpa'/ de las rang nyid/ de las dkyil 'khor de las snod bcud kyi bar rim gyis kun tu snang bar byas nas slar yang de bzhin du rim gyis bsdus te thig le la thim pa'i thig le las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'bab par yun ring du bsam par bya'o/ / de nas thig le la sems brtan pa na/ thig le'i nang du lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis gsal btab la dkyil 'khor thig le dang bcas pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer rang gi ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas 'phros te phyi nang thams cad snang bas khyab par bsgoms pas bying ba mtha' dag sel bar nus so/ / gnyis pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis nam mkha'i khams gang ba'i rigs lnga la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/

rang gi zhal nas zhugs pa byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa yongs su gyur pa las zla ba la gnas pa'i ral gri nas 'bru tsam gyi yu ba'i dbus su/ tsa na ka'i 'bru tsam gyi thig le ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od zer shin tu gsal ba'i nang du/ lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa skad cig gis gsal btab ste/ de la yun ring du sems bzung bas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags rnams 'char bar 'gyur la/ mtshan ma de 'dra ma mthong gi bar du mi spro zhing*/ mthong nas dkyil 'khor du ma yang dang yang du spros te/ 'gro ba'i don byas nas slar yang bsdu ba'i spro bsdu la bslab par bya'o/ /bsgoms pas skye na bzlas pa bya ba ni/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje ye shes sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs kar/ rlung dang chu dang me dang sa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas par gyur pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar maṃ gyi mthar bzlas pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ rdo rje bzhi'i thugs ka'i oṃ āḥmaṃ hūṃ rnams las/ rlung 'gro 'ong dang lhan cig rdo rje gsum rim pas sam cig car spros/ nam mkha' gang ba la lha mo rnams kyis 'khyud pa sogs mchod pas mnyes shing*/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas maṃ gyis 'od zer gyis bsdus te yig 'bru rnams la thim par bsam la/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūṃ zhes gtso bor bzlas shing*/ gzhan yang oṃ āḥmañju badz+ra maṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdzi na dz-ika hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrat+na dhṛka aṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.a ro l̥ka hrīḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyā dhṛka khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmo ha ra tī laṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ra tī maṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrā ga ra tī paṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dā ra tī taṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra dzāḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥshap+ta badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥgan+dha badz+ra baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā ra sa badz+rā ho hūṃ/ oṃ āḥspar+sha badz+ra khaṃ hūṃ/

oṃ āḥdharma dhā tu badz+rā raṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyān+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpad+mān+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ ces bzlas pa bya'o/ /gal te sgom bzlas kyis dub na/ lha mo bzhis glus bskul bar bsam nas/ dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod bya'o/ / gal te lus stobs nyams par gyur na/ spyi bo nas mtho gang tsam gyis 'phags par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ de'i 'og phyogs kyi dbus su oṃ dkar po las ye shes bdud rtsi lnga babs te/ spyi bo nas zhugs lus thams cad gang brlan dang drod kyis khyab par bsams na/ mi rgas pa dang*/ lus rgyas par 'gyur ba sogs bshad do/ / dkyil 'khor bsdu bar 'dod na sku'i rigs rnams sku rdo rje dang*/ gsung gi rigs rnams gsung rdo rje dang*/ thugs kyi rigs rnams thugs rdo rje la thim pa'i tshul gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang la thim par gyur pas/ rdo rje gsum shin tu brtan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ thun mtshams spyod lam thams cad du snang ba thams cad/ rdo rje gsum gyis ngo bor mos pa dang*/ rang lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos snod bcud thams cad snang stong sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya'o/ / kha zas gtor ma ltar gyis gyis brlabs/ snying gar zla ba la maṃ yig lha thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa mchod pa'i bsam pas bza' zhing*/ phyi nang gi sbyin sreg gis phung khams 'od gsal du sreg pa'i rten 'brel sgrig pa dang*/ gzhan don byed pa rnams rgyal ba la mchod pa dang*/ lus phyag rgya dang*/ ngag sngags dang*/ bya ba thams cad thabs shes khyad par can gyis zin pas dge bar bsgyur bar bya'o/ /dam tshig nyams na/ rang dam tshig rdo rje don yod grub par bsgoms te/ snying gar zla ba la sna tshogs rdo rje khaṃ ljang gus mtshan pa sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ hūṃ zhes bzlas shing*/

dbang rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba blangs pas dag par 'gyur ro/ khrus la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor skad cig gis gsal btab nas/ thugs kyi lam gyi 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur zhing bkrus par bsam par bya'o/ /nyal ba'i tshe mchod bstod byas nas dkyil 'khor snying ga'i maṃ la thim/ der stong pa nyid dang snying rje dbyer med pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag ste gnyid par bya'o/ / ldang ba'i tshe/ tshad med bzhi'i rang bzhin lha mo bzhis bskul te/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor langs par bsam/ gal te bar chad kyi mtshan ma mthong na/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rnal 'byor gyis dbang bskur ba blangs te bgegs gzhom par bya'o/ /gal te lha tshogs la mchod par 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal byas te yi ge 'bru gsum gyi sngags kyis tshom bu bkod la/ lha so so'i rang sngags kyis dam tshig pa lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor bskyed nas/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ skye mched de dang sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs/ dbang bskur rgyas btab bya/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ lha re re bzhin du lha sngags kyis mthar rdzas sngags sbyar bas/ chu gsum nyer spyod rnams re re zhing so sor phul la/ rol mo/ 'dod yon drug /rgyal srid sna bdun la sogs pa'i mchod pa thams cad spyi mthun du phul/ nang mchod kyang so sor phul la/ bstod pa dang gtor ma dang rdo rje'i glu gar la sogs pas mchod de/ yan lag bdun pa byas la/ smon lam dang gsol ba yang dang yang du gdab/ dngos grub blangs la bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs te bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod par bya'o/ / thun mtshams thams cad dam thun tha ma la nges par gtor ma 'bul bar bya dgos pas dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad dang shar dang nub kyi g.yas su re re ste ba lci'i maṇ+ḍal bcu gcig / dbus mar me tog gi tshom bu bcu dgu shar dang byang du nyis sgrig

/shar gyi g.yas su sum sgrig / nub kyi g.yas su nyis sgrig rnams bkod/ gzhan rnams su re re/ de dag re re zhing gtor ma dang mchod pa rgyas pa 'grub na bya/ ma grub kyang*/ zas bzang dgu sha dang myos byed kyis brgyan pa/ bdud rtsi lngas brgyan pa'i gtor ma gnyis mchod pa dang bcas pa mdun du bshams la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan dang yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyis steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang gi shar du/ bh+rūṃ las dri chen bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lhor aṃ las rak+ta aṃ gis mtshan pa/ nub tu dz+riṃ las byang sems dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ las sha chen khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ dbus su hūṃ las dri chu hūṃ gi mtshan pa/ thun mong g-i steng du oṃ yig dkar po 'od zer 'phro bar gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i maṃ gyi 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs te/ rang rang gi sa bon la thim zhing*/ rlung g.yos te me sbar bas rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol/ dri ma thams cad sbyangs shing kha dog dmar ser nyi ma 'char kha'i mdog can gsal zhing dwangs par gyur/ de'i rlangs pa gyen du 'phyur ba las byung ba'i hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba gsum yang bar snang de nyid du zhu ba thod par lhung bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zag pa med pa'i ro dang bcud kyis brgyan par byas/ oṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na gnas pa'i snod bcud kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug nas bstims pas rgya cher spel zhing byin gyis brlabs par gyur/
oṃ āḥhūṃ

lan gsum brjod/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ aṃ paṃ aṃ pūṃ dhuṃ aṃ gaṃ naiṃ shaṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ rnams te mchod rdzas so so'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa rnams dang sa bon rnams so sor zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ me tog / 'dug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog / zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas thams cad rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin phung*/ byed las rang bzhin gyis dbang po mtha' dag zag med kyi bde bas tshim par byed pas phyi nang kun tu gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ āñca ma naṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta/ rū pa/ par+ṣa/ gan+dha/ rā sa/ spar+sha/ dharma dhā tu āḥhūṃ/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes gdan phul te bzhugs par bsam/ mdun bskyed kyi lha thams cad kyi ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi bu gu gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ rgyas par na oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka sarba duṣ+tan sa ma ya mu dra pra bhañja ka ma ma shān+tiṃ ku ru rak+ṣa tsa ku ru swāhā hūṃ/ zhes sam/ gzhan 'dra ba la/ shan+tiṃ ku ru swāhā rak+ṣaṃ ku ru hūṃ/ puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ/ wa shaṃ ku ru ho/ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa u tsa ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ a kar+ṣa ya hrīḥdza/ zhes lan bdun gyis mi bskyod pa dang*/ badz+ra dhṛka gi mtshams su lha rnams kyi mtshan so sor bcug ste lan gsum gsum gyis lha tshogs rnams la dbul bar bya'o/ / badz+ra dhṛka gi gnas su/ mañju badz+ra zhes bcu pa ni 'jam pa'i rdo rje la'o/ / 'bring du na/ gong du bshad pa'i phreng ba'i sngags kyi mthar/ sarba duṣ+tan sogs sbyar ba lan bdun dbul/

bsdu na oṃ āḥhūṃ/ maṃ/ bh+ruṃ/ aṃ/ dz+riṃ/ khaṃ/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ kha raṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ pañca a mṛ ta hūṃ zhes pa gsum mam lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ gal te khro bo so so la brten nas las 'tshol ba yin na/ khro bo so so'i phreng sngags kyis sgos su lan mang du 'bul zhing las la bskul ba yin no/ /mthar tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin mchod pa phul la/ de nyid lnga pas bstod nas/ rdo rje gsum dngos mi phyed sku/ /ye shes lnga ldan bde ba che/ /'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / zhes sogs 'phrin las gzhol/ 'jig rten pa'i lha tshogs rnams la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer nag po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes bkug ste gong ltar gdan phul la/ phyogs rnams su 'khod pa ni/ shar du brgya byin ser po rdo rje 'dzin pa mig stong dang ldan pa glang po che la bzhon cing*/ bde sogs ma la 'khyud pa/ de'i g.yon du khyab 'jug nag po mkha' lding la bzhon pa/ phyag bzhis ga ḍa'i dbyug pa 'khor lo dung nor bu rnams 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la bzhon pa/ phyag bzhi skyabs sbyin phreng ba dbyug gu gsum pa ghun dhe rnams 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje nag po ma he'i steng na brkyang bskum du gnas pa/ dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lho nub tu srin po nag po sbom thung khro bo'i lus can mi ro la bzhon pa/ ral gri dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po sbrul la bzhon pa/ sbrul zhags 'dzin pa sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang gu ri dwags dgo ba ser po la bzhon pa/ rlung ras nam mkha' la brkyangs shing 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po mi la bzhon pa/ bi dzā pu ra dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/

de'i g.yas su log 'dren dkar po glang po'i gdong can byi ba la bzhon pa/ phyag bzhis/ la phug phreng ba la du dbyug pa rnams 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang phyug dkar po glang la bzhon pa/ ral pa'i cod pan dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rtse gsum dang ḍā ma ru 'dzin pa/ dbang po dang dbang phyug gi bar du nyi ma dmar po rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la bzhon pa/ pad+ma dmar po 'dzin pa/ de'i g.yon du zla ba dkar po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa ut+pal dkar po 'dzin pa/ de gnyis kyi dbus su tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la bzhon pa bram ze mi'u thung gi rnam pa can gdong bzhi pa/ dbyug gu dang phreng ba 'dzin pa/ chu lha dang bden bral gyi bar du/ thags bzang rigs nag po shing rta la gnas pa ral gri dang phub 'dzin pa/ de'i g.yon du sa'i lha mo ser mo sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa/ bum pa bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa 'od kyis mun pa sel bar byed pa rigs mthun gyi 'khor dpag tu med pa bskor ba'o/ /mchod yon dang nyer spyod kyis mchod la/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer las byung ba'i rdo rje phur bu bcu/ stod rang rang gi phyogs kyi srung 'khor gyi khro bo'i dbyibs su gnas pa/ lte ba man chad rdo rje rtse gcig pa lta bu shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa spros nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i khro bo spros te/ g.yon pas phur bu'i mgul ba nas bzung*/ g.yas pa rdo rje tho bas spyi bo nas brdung zhing sngags 'di brjod par bya ste/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta sarba duṣ+taṃ in+d+ra sa pa ri wā rā ṇa kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyā ta kṛta/ sarba duṣ+taṃ ya ma sa pa ri wā rā ṇa kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥpad+mān+ta kṛta/ sarba duṣ+taṃ nā ga sa pa ri wā rā ṇa kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta sarba duṣ+taṃ ku be ra ga ṇa pa dhi sa pa ri wā rā ṇa kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ āḥṭaki rā dzā sarba duṣ+taṃ āg+ne sa pa ri wā rā ṇa kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥnī la daṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+taṃ ni ri ti sa pa ri wā rā ṇa kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥmahā bā la sarba duṣ+taṃ wa yu sa pa ri wā rā ṇa kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ.a tsa la sarba duṣ+taṃ ī shwa ra sa pa ri wā rā ṇa kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥtsakra brti sarba duṣ+taṃ arka tsan+t+ra pra ti mahā' na sa pa ri wā ra ṇa kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥsum+bha rā dzā sarba duṣ+taṃ bai ma tsi tri pri th+wī de wi sa pa ri wā rā ṇa kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de ltar phur bus btab pas/ ma dag pa'i lus sems 'od gsal chen po'i dbyings su bcom zhing brlag par byas nas/ rnam par shes pa mar me lta bu thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis drangs te zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas/ lha mo'i mtsho skyes su babs pa thig le'i ngo bor gnas par gyur/ oṃ āḥ oṃ shrī he ru ka badz+ra sa ma ya hrīḥ sarba duṣ+taṃ sa ma ya mu dra wan/ tsakra e ṣaṃ/ ā ṣa do ṣāṃ/ ā pa na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces he ru ka'i sngags kyis de rnams kyi shes sgrib dang gnod sems bsal/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phreng sngags kyi dzi bi tān+ta ka rā ya zhes pa'am mjug tu/ sarbe ṣu ā sha do ṣāṃ ā pa na ya hūṃ phaṭa ces btags pa bzlas pas nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ thig le de nyid cha bco lngar gyur te/ badz+raṃ/ hūṃ/ raṃ/ kaṃ/ muṃ/ baṃ/ yaṃ/ bhaṃ/ shauṃ/ maṃ/ aṃ/ beṃ/ maṃ maṃ laṃ zhes pa rnams su gyur/ de dag kyang rim pas/ rdo rje 'khor lo ghu dhe dang*/ /dbyug pa gri dang sbrul zhags dang*/ /rlung ras shing thog pad+ma dang*/ /rtse gsum pad+ma ut+pal dang*/ /pad+ma ma ral gri pad+ma rnams/ /rang rang sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ /de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ /'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams su gyur/ /dbang po klu dang rlung lha dang*/ /dbang ldan zla ba tshangs pa dang*/ /sa lha mo rnams zla bar gnas/

/nye dbang me dang gshin rje dang*/ / srin po gnod sbyin tshogs bdag dang*/ /nyi ma dang ni thags bzang ris/ /'di dag nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /de yang shar du rdo rje mtshon cha ser po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na 'khor lo dang pad+ma/ de'i g.yon phyogs su rdo rje sgyu ma sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /g.yas gnyis na 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na dung dang pad+ma/ shar lhor rdo rje me dmar po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na bgrang phreng dang mi 'jigs pa ster ba/ g.yon gnyis na dbyug pa dang ghun+dhe/ lhor rdo rje dus nag po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi / g.yas gnyis na dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang rin po che/ lho nub tu rdo rje gtun shing nag po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi / g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu rdo rje klu dkar po 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /g.yas gnyis na sbrul zhags dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang rin po che/ nub byang du rdo rje rlung ljang gu don grub kyi cod pan can/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /g.yas gnyis na gos dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang rin po che/ byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed ser po 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /g.yas gnyis na bi dza pu ra dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang ne'u le thogs pa/ de'i g.yas phyogs na rdo rje sna ring dkar po 'od dpag med kyi cod can/

dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na la phug dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang pad+ma'i chang gis bkang ba'i kha phor/ byang shar du rdo rje khro bo dkar po 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na rtse gsum dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang pad+ma/ dbang po'i g.yas kyi maṇ+ḍal du rdo rje 'khyil ba dmar po rin 'byung gi cod pan can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na pad+ma dmar po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang rin chen/ de'i g.yon du rdo rje 'od dkar po rnam snang gi dbu brgyan can/ phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na ut+pal dkar po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang pad+ma/ dbus su rdo rje mi smra ser po rnam snang gi cod pan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na pad+ma ser po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang rin chen/ nub dang bden bral gyibar du rdo rje thags bzang ris sngon po rnam snang gi cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang pad+ma/ de'i g.yon du sa'i lha mo ser po rnam snang gi cod pan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na pad+ma ser po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis na rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lha'i gos dang phreng ba dang*/ byug pa dang ldan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs pa 'od kyi drwa ba 'gyed pa'i sku can no/ / bsdu na/ rang rang gi phyogs kyi ming dang rang rang gi ming dang kha dog tsam brjod nas 'di dag thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng na

zhes sogs tsam zhig brjod kyang rung ngo*/ / de nas rdo rje ma drug dang*/ nyer spyod kyis mchod nas/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ste/ gtor ma 'bul ba las/ kho bo cag gi bla ma dag gi man ngag ni 'di yin te/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra yud dha sarba duṣ+taṃ sa ma ya nas hrīḥdzaḥ zhes dbang po la 'bul ba dang*/ yang na mtshan mthar a kā ro 'i sngags btags nas phul kyang rung bar bshad pa bzhin dang*/ badz+ra yud+dha'i gnas su ma ya badz+ra dang*/ badz+ra a na la dang*/ badz+ra kā la dang*/ badz+ra mu sa la dang*/ nā ka badz+ra dang*/ badz+ra a nī la dang*/ badz+ra shauṇ+ḍa dang*/ badz+ra bhe ra ba dang*/ badz+ra kro dha dang*/ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li dang*/ badz+ra pra bha dang*/ mo ha badz+ra dang*/ be ma tsi tri dang*/ pri thī de ba ta zhes pa rnams bcug nas so sor lan gsum sogs phul/ de nas oṃ āḥ dus gsum skyes pa kun dang phyogs bcu yi/ /'jig rten khams rnams nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi bkod pa rab 'byams kyi/ /shin tu phra ba'i rdul skyes dkyil 'khor ni/ /phan tshun gcig gi nang du gcig son pa/ /snyoms par 'jug par kun tu gnas pa yi/ /chos kyi dbyings su yang dag par 'du zhing*/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi yongs su mthar thug pa'i/ /dus gsum skyes pa kun dang phyogs bcu yi/ /'jig rten khams rnams mtha' yas sprin bkod pa/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams mnyam dang 'jig rten skyong*/ /kun dang sems can kun kyang 'di lta ste/ /rdo rje mtshon cha sgyu ma rdo rje dang*/ /rdo rje me dang rdo rje dus dang ni/ /rdo rje gtun shing rdo rje klu dag dang*/ /rdo rje rlung dang rdo rje 'jigs byed dang*/ /rdo rje sna ring rdo rje khro bo dang*/ /rdo rje 'khyil ba rdo rje 'od dang ni/ /mi smra rdo rje dang ni thags bzang ris/ /sa yi lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /me tog dag dang bdug pa mar me dang*/ /dri dang lha bshos la sogs yang dag ldan/ /nye bar spyod pa dang ni gtor ma 'di/

/so sor bzhes shing nye bar longs spyod nas/ / bdag gi dbyig gser nor 'bru lang tsho tshe/ /nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa rnams/ /'phrog par byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren kun/ /sdang dang rab tu sdang ba thams cad dang*/ /mi dang mi ma yin rnams rmongs par mdzod/ /rengs dang bcing dang rnam par 'jigs par mdzod/ /bdag la dbyig gser nor 'bru lang tsho tshe/ /nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa dang*/ /bde ba chen po rab tu 'phel ba rnams/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i mthar thug par/ /gnang bar mdzad cing rtag tu stongs grogs dang*/ /zhi ba dang ni bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ /hūṃ zhes pas spyi khyab tu phul la/ thal mo sbyar te/ kyai bcos ldan 'das ni rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mchog /skyon can kun gyi phyag rgya bshig pa po/ /bdag gi gtor phul bdag la zhi ba dang*/ /dus 'di nas ni bsrung ba mdzad du gsol/ / zhes gsol ba 'debs pa bskyar ba lan gsum maṃ bdun la sogs pa bya/ de nas de thams cad kyi legs so zhes gsung bas dgyes pa dang*/ dngos grub ci 'dod pa stsal bar zhal gyis bzhes par bsam/ der mchod bstod bsdus pa cig spro na bya/

khyed rnams kyis bdag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsol ba dang*/ las thams cad sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ yi ge brgya pa mang du bya/ 'jig rten 'di na 'khod pa'i mgron rnams kun/ /phyogs skyong sems can kun dang lha yi lha/ /rang bzhin gyis grub sbyor bas sbyangs pa rnams/ /bdag ni brtson dang mi ldan bkren chen te/ /mchod gzhan ci yang bdag la ma mchis na/ /gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon po khyed rnams kyis/ / thugs dang mi 'gal rang gi mthus bzhes shig /bdag ni rnam g.yengs rmugs dang le lo yis/ /sems ma 'dul dang mi gsal ba bsgrubs pas/ /mgon po khyed rnams thugs dang 'gal ba dang*/ /rang bzhin dag gi chos gzigs bzod pa mdzod/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs pa dang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na twā ta/ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ smon lam gdab cing bkra shis kyang bya'o/ / de ltar bzlas pa dang*/ bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor la mchod pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bcud len dang*/ dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdu ba dang*/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dang*/ zas kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ bya ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ dam tshig gso ba dang*/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bar chad zlog pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma ste/ bcu bzhi po de dag ni rjes spyod yan lag dang bcas pa'o/ kho bo cag gi bla ma dam pa'i man ngag /gal te rang gzhan gyi don du gtor chen bya bar 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal mchod pa dang gtor chog sbrags pa yin te/ gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs/ bsrung 'khor rgyas pa dang bcas pa'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyangs/ thun mong gi bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su/ bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed/

lha bskyed cing mchod gtod 'bul ba gong dang 'dra ba las/ lha mo bzhi dang khro bo bcu la phreng sngags kyis 'bul ba yin te/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wā la tiṣ+ṭha/ sid+dhi lo tsā ni/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ya swā hā/ zhes spyan ma dang*/ oṃ shang ka re/ shān+ti ka re ghuṭ+ṭa guṭ+ṭa ghuṭ+ṭi ni ghuṭ+ṭi ni ghā ta ya ghā ta ya ghuṭ+ṭi ni swāhā/ zhes mā ma kī dang*/ oṃ kaṭ+ṭe bi kaṭ+ṭe ni kaṭ+ṭe ka ṭaṃ ka ṭe swāhā/ gos dkar mo dang*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ sgrol ma dang*/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wak+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba duṣ+ta satwa da ma ka /a si mu sa la/ pa ra shu pā sha haste tsa tur+bhu dza tsa turmu kha ṣaXṭa tsa ra ṇa ā gats+tsha sarba duṣ+ta prā ṇa a pa hā ri ṇe/ mahā bi gh+na ghā ta ka /bi kri tā na na sarba bhū ta/ bha yaṃ ka ra aṭ+ṭa ṭ+ṭahā sa nā dai ne/ bya gh+ra tsarma ba sa na/ ku ru ku ru sarba karmā ṇi/ tshin+da tshin+da sarba man+t+raṃ bhin+da bhin+da pa ra mu drāṃ/ ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ sarba bhū tā n/ ma tha ma tha nirma tha nirma tha sarba duṣ+tāṃ/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ maṇ+ḍal la ma dh+yeḥ bai ba swa ta/ dzī bi tān+ta ka ra/ ma ma sarba kar+yaṃ ku ru ku ru da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa/ mā bi laṃ ba/ mā bi laṃ ba/ sa ma ya ma nurma ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya sarban+nā sha ya/ ka ra ka ra bigh+na na/ sarba ā sha pa ri pū ra ka he he bha bān/ kiñci rā ya si ma ma sarba ar+thān sā dha ya swāhā/ zhes gshin rje gshed dang*/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya bāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ oṃ hūṃ dzi na ri ṭiṭ+ṭa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes shes rab mthar byed dang*/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya bāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇaṃ/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ta ru la bi ru la sarba bi ṣa ghā ta ya dzā li ta/ bi s+phu liṅga/ aṭ+ṭa ṭ+ṭa hā sa ke sa ri sa ṭa ā ṭo pa/ badz+ra khu ra nar+ghā ta na tsa li ra ba su dhā ta la ni shwa sa/ ma ru tot k+ṣi ba ta dhā ra ṇi dha ra/

bhī ṣa ṇa/ aṭ+ṭaṭ+ṭa hā sa a pa ri mi ta ba la/ pā rā kra ma/ ār+ya ga na bhī ta bhū ta ga ṇa dhu ṣi ta/ bu dh+ya bu dh+ya hā ya grī ba/ khā da khā da/ pā ra man+t+ran/ tshin+da tshin+da sid+dhi ma me di sha /a be sha ya ā be sha ya/ sarba dz+wa ra pi shā tsān/ sarba gra he ṣu/ a pra ti ha to bha ba badz+ra daṃṣ+ta kiñci rā ya si/ i daṃ duṣ+ta gra haṃ duṣ+ta sarbaṃ bā/ dhu na dhu na/ ma tha ma tha marda mardi pā ṭa ya ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ bud+dha dharma sad+gha a nu dz+nyā taṃ karma ku ru ha ya grī bā ya phaṭa/ badz+ra phaṭa/ badz+ra ga tra ya phaṭa/ badz+ra ne trā ya phaṭa/ badz+ra daṃ ṣ+tā ya phaṭa/ badz+ra khu rā ya phaṭa/ badz+ra khu ra nir+ghā ta nā ya phaṭa/ trai lokya bha yaṃ ka rā ya phaṭa/ sarba karme ṣu a pra ti ha tā ya phaṭa/ badz+ra ku la san+t+ra sa nā ya phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pad+ma mthar byed dang*/ na maḥ sa man+ta kā ya bāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ na mo mahā badz+ra kro dhā ya/ mahā daṃṣ+taṭ+ko ṭa bhai na bā ya/ a si mu sa la par+shu pā sha hastā ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha khā hi khā hi tiṣ+ṭha ban+dha ban+dha ha na ha na da ha da ha/ gardza gardza bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bi gh+na bi nā ya kān mahā ga ṇa pa dhi dzī bi tān+ta ka rā ya swāhā/ zhes bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang*/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya bāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ a tsa la kā na/ tsaṇ+ḍa naṭ+ṭa naṭ+ṭa maṭ+ṭa ni maṭ+ṭa/ moṭ+ṭa moṭ+ṭa/ taṭ+ṭa taṭ+ṭa/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ mo ha mo ha mo ha ka ra/ sa ha sa ha/ badz+ra ha saṃ ku ru/ ha sa ha sa marda raṭa marda raṭa/ gardza gardza/ ha na ha na ban+dha ban+dha tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ā bi sha /mahā man+t+ra pā ma ka /dhu na dhu na ti ṇi ti ṇi khā da khā da bi gh+nan mā ra ya mā ra ya duṣ+taṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa sarban/ ku ru ku ru/ ki ri ki ri/ mahā bi ṣa badz+ra s+pho ṭā ya s+pho ṭā ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ tri bā li/ ta raṅga narta ka /aṃ aṃ aṃ/ hāṃ hāṃ hāṃ/ a tsa la tse ṭa/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya hūṃ hūṃ/ a sa man+ti ka /trāt mahā bā la shā ta ya/

pa ra man+t+rāṃ/ aṃ aṃ haṃ haṃ māṃ/ shu dha shu dh+ya tu/ lo kastu ṣad+ya tu badz+rī/ na mastu/ a pra ti ha ta bā le bh+yāḥ/ dz+wā la ya trā ṭā/ a sa ha na maḥswāhā/ zhes mi g.yo ba dang*/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya bāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇaṃ/ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ zhes 'dod rgyal dang*/ na mas+sa man+ta kā ya bāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇaṃ/ oṃ e h+ye he/ bha ga bān+nī la badz+ra daṇ+ḍa/ tu ru tu ru hu lu hu lu/ hā hā/ gu lu gu lu/ gu lā pa ya gu lā pa ya/ kra ma kra ma bhā ga wān/ bā yu be ge na/ bhū tān/ shī gh+raṃ/ da ha da ha/ ra da ra ba ha ba ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ma tha ma tha/ pā ta ya pā ta ya/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ mo ṭā pa ya mo ṭā pa ya/ sarba karmā ṇi tshin+da tshin+da bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣaya me daṃ a pya/ me daṃ madz+dza ru dhi ra pri ya e h+ye he/ bha ga wan/ sarba bi gh+na ni/ sarba mū la karmā ṇi/ kri ti ma bi ṣā di ni/ sarba gra hān/ ha na ha na/ bhañja bhañja/ marda marda i dam me kar+yaṃ sā dhā ya/ hūṃ nī la ya/ nī la badz+ra daṇ+ḍa ya tu ru tu ru bi gh+nan+bhi nā ya kaṃ /nā sha ya nā sha ya/ hu ru hu ru dip+ta tsaṇ+ḍā ya/ sarba sha trūn ṇaṃ/ hṛ da yā ni/ pī ḍa ya tshin+da tshin+da/ pa ra bi d+ya ni tshe da ka hūṃ/ bi d+yā nāṃ shiṣ+ta ka sa ma ya ma nusma ra/ badz+ra dhā ra ba tsa na/ marma ṇi ni grin+ta hūṃ/ ha na ha na da ha da ha/ ku ru ku ru tu ru tu ru hu ru hu ru phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ/ kri tan+tā ya/ de ba ṛ ṣi/ bi drā pa kā ya/ ha na ha na/ badz+ra daṇ+ḍe na swāhā/ zhes dbyig sngon can dang*/ na ma sa man+ta kā ya bāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ u gra shū la pā ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ dz+yo ti nirnā da hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ mahā bā la swāhā/ zhes stobs po che dang*/ gong du brjod pa'i phyir zlog gi sngags kyis gtsug tor bsgyur ba dang*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ gṛh+na gṛh+na hūṃ/ gṛh+na pā ya gṛh+na pā ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bi d+ya rā dza huṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/

zhes pas gnod mdzes la gtor ma 'bul te/ yang thog mar dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i rjes su/ phyogs skyong rnams kyang bskyed nas/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshe dkyil 'khor pa dang 'jig rten pa'i sngags sbrel nas phul kyang rung ste/ mjug tu mchod bstod dang rdo rje'i glu blang ba la sogs pa byas nas/ sa phyogs gtsang sar rol mo'i sgra chen po dang bcas nas bskyal bas/ so so'i las thogs pa med par 'grub pa yin no/ /lha mo bzhi'i las tshogs rnams dang*/ gshin rje gshed kyis bu mo dgug pa dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil bas bskrad pa dang*/ rta mgrin gyis dug zhi ba dang*/ gzhan gyi mi thub pas srin po la sogs pa'i gdon gyis 'dzin par byed pa dang*/ be con sngon pos gsod pa dang*/ stobs po ches char 'bebs pa dang*/ ṭak+kis dbang du byed pa dang*/ mi g.yo bas lha mo sogs dgug pa dang*/ sa 'og gis lha min mo dang klu mo sogs dgug pa dang*/ gtsug tor gyis phyir zlog rnams la las tshogs gzhung las 'byung ba bzhin dang*/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i dbus kyi maṇ+ḍal du khro bo de rnams nyid so so'i las kyi skabs la 'god pa yin no/ / de ltar bskyed rim goms pa brtan pa na las tshogs rnams bsgrub par bya ba dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i man ngag ni gzhan du shes par bya la/ de ltar rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor gyis ye shes la cung zad dbang bar gyur pa na/ thun mong g-i dngos grub chen po rnams kyang sgrub cing*/ sems can sna tshogs pa rnams don chen po la gzud pa'i phyir/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod cing des ye shes la yang dag par dbang bar 'gyur/ de nas phyag rgya'i sbyor ba las nang gi sa bcu mngon du byas te/ dus gsum gyis sangs rgyas thams cad ye shes kyi sku rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa yin no/ / brgyad khri bzhi stong chos rnams kun gyi snod/ /ma lus rgyud sde kun gyi rgyal po ni/
